answer_1.quote: the objective of a CSC model is to generate a corresponding corrected sentence

answer_2.quote: Following the mainstream evaluation metrics for CSC tasks, we report the Precision (P), Recall (R), and F1 scores of the correction subtask at both the sentence-and character-level, denoted as S-P/R/F and C-P/R/F, respectively. To comprehensively evaluate the model's correction capability, we also include the false positive rate (FPR) as an additional metric.
